testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep Tools key tips visible after Escape with a face selected ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And one visible solid face is selected ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is selected ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then top-level key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls ✔ And key tips appear on the Tools ribbon commands ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the top-level and Tools command key tips remain visible ✔ And the Tools ribbon and part remain visible ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then the ribbon key tips disappear ✔ And the selection indicator still reports one face
